stem: In which sentence does the author seem to accept that technology on Mount Everest is inevitable?

options.label: A
options.text: This was what many travelers were looking for: places so hard to get to, and so different from the world we knew, that their very existence seemed almost miraculous.

options.label: B
options.text: When I first trekked the Everest route, in October 1983, it felt as though I'd entered a world completely detached from the familiar.

options.label: C
options.text: Sitting in a cozy inn, immersed in conversation, was far more seductive than surfing the Web.

options.label: D
options.text: We are far past the time when we can expect to find a Shangri-La, anywhere, beyond the reach of the Internet.
